notes: Probes: 'MATH 100' 0.87, 'CHEM 201 or BIO 110' 0.73, 'Yamaha DX100' 0.85, 'PSY 310 and ECON 205' 0.59, 'P1102' 0.26; '100 people ... in 2006' 0.01, '300 people' 0.00, '250 grams' 0.05, years 0.01. One exception: '3,127 ft ... 1,104 miles' 0.55, so some comma-grouped quantities fire as well.
